info.description: The SVG artwork the site draws from. Navigation and page content pick an icon from here, so adding one is an upload rather than a code change.

name.description: What this icon depicts, for people browsing the list.

key.description: What content refers to this icon by, e.g. sql. Unique within a set, because the same word means different artwork in different places: cloud is a cloud in the menus and a cube on a product pillar.

set.description: Where this icon is used. nav: menus, feature lists and link cards. pillar: the glyph above a product pillar card. scale: the brand-blue cards. feature: the small icons over embedded-analytics points.

svg.description: An SVG file. Draw it with stroke="currentColor" or fill="currentColor" so it takes the colour of whatever it sits in and can animate on hover; a hardcoded colour will stay put while its neighbours change.
